title: Ghost Market
overview: Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all... his own family.

title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: A Minecraft Movie Squared
overview: The second installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: The 08' Club
overview: Dick Negroni begins as a composed bartender at the '08 Club who trades his mixing tins for a life of crime after catching the eye of the powerful mob boss Don Gog. Alongside his volatile partners, Dick must navigate a treacherous path of betrayal and escalating madness where the line between professional "cleanup" and total lunacy begins to blur.

title: Shredded Cheese
overview: A mockumentary follows a young man whose uncontrollable addiction to shredded cheese begins to disrupt his daily life and worry the people around him.

title: X502C
overview: Set in an unknown space and time, a hyperconnected world dominated by technological dogmas, wireless cities and near total collapse, where there are no differences between human and machine, Thom will search for answers in his own history, hoping to preserve his remaining humanity.

title: Ray Gunn
overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

title: Super Champions
overview: Seven people think about their place in the universe.

title: Prima Facie
overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

title: Medicine Ball
overview: Medicine Ball follows Native college athletes Lexus and Leroy as they uncover their university’s dark history as a former Indian boarding school, revealing how basketball is more than a game—it’s a symbol of hope, resilience, and cultural pride in Native communities.

title: Pactum
overview: Six high-society women gather in a mansion bound by a secret pact, a pact one of them has broken and whose consequences will be disastrous. Who is the traitor?

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Pūtaringa
overview: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

title: Gentle by Birth
overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Playback
overview: When a mysterious camcorder appears in their home, a couple's buried sins manifest in terrifying ways.

title: Better Than A Shovel
overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: The Teenage Vampire
overview: When a straightlaced young woman moves into a chic bungalow in the Hollywood Hills she imagines nothing but raging parties and romance in her future. But Sandra's new dream house quickly becomes a den of horrors after she discovers her landlords are ancient vampires and her first party guests are the victims of a bloody massacre. As the night grows more sinister and twisted, Sandra unearths the most terrifying secret of all.

title: In The Ever
overview: Blending intimate voice-over with the fractured memories of a 1970s folksinger, IN THE EVER follows Sam Ellis, a mechanic, whose songs written for his dead mother become a surprise hit. Unable to cope with fame, Sam retreats to a desert ranch, where an unexpected love affair forces him to confront his pain in order to move forward.  The film is a love letter infused in music. With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

title: Tabby Daly
overview: As the potato blight tears through a rural community, a charitable woman helps young boys emigrate in search of a better life. But as quiet doubts begin to surface, questions emerge about her true intentions.

title: Not John
overview: After recently traveling together through Europe, a group of six friends discovers that one of them may have returned as a changeling.

title: Lucrum
overview: Summoned to the secluded estate of a celebrated pianist, young adoptee June discovers a world of beauty and artistic brilliance sustained by a terrifying covenant. A haunting work of folk horror where refinement masks something far more insatiable.

title: Hide
overview: A reclusive hunter clashes with her ambitious son over whether or not to capitalize on a tragic, coveted  family heirloom.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Encyclopedia Galactica
overview: In ancient days, humans would look at the stars and dream of an endless future; every point of light emblematic of a new horizon to cross, a new frontier to conquer, a destiny to claim. But this future would not come to pass. Instead, the future would see the human race gone, our pan-galactic society torn apart by the strains of expansion. The planets settled during humanity’s diaspora lay abandoned, with all traces of our presence eroding into ruin and dust; an ancient cosmic ecosystem swallowing our collective remains. And despite our absence, those hopeful, naive dreams of that now-ancient era still echo across the galaxy, for any who choose to intercept them.

title: Red Ledger
overview: Captain Georgina Lee captures and interrogates Ellis's handler on why she was sent to disarm weapons. But a piece of Lee's history is brought up that she can't escape.

title: A Country Dog
overview: Based on Shirley Jackson's short story "The Renegade," A Country Dog follows a family whose move from the city to an isolated rural community promises a fresh start until their beloved dog is accused of killing a neighbor's chickens.

title: El Frío Que Guía Luz
overview: While waiting for the bus, a single mother is suddenly swept into her painful past as she tells her six-year-old daughter a tale.

title: Jie
overview: A young Chinese boy, Jie, navigates a new life in the U.S. while facing quiet family tensions and begins to grow through an unexpected friendship.

title: Little Birds
overview: Two girls escape from their bleak world into one of their own; but when their game of flight takes a dark turn, one is left to face the consequences alone.

title: A Mourning Star
overview: Our story follows a young boy lost in a forest who encounters a mysterious fallen star. The star offers to guide him home but as their journey unfolds, it becomes clear that things aren’t quite as simple as they seem.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: 5 Days With Boy5
overview: An interviewer spends 5 days following a passionate singer as he prepares his questionable dynamic of a boy band for the biggest performance of their career.

title: Freakshow
overview: While a group of mimes are getting ready for a performance, one of them reaches a breaking point.

title: Iron Fisted Tyrant 2
overview: James Wylie's 2025 conclusion to the Time franchise, 'Saving Time', was a feature length motion picture released to critical acclaim.  But just what do the people behind the picture have to say about it? 'Iron Fisted Tyrant 2' is a documentary that asks the audience questions about power and control in the arts, the nature of adversarial relationships, and the strength of reconciliation.

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: The Descendant
overview: Something is living in my house.

title: Stars on the Ceiling
overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

title: Loulou
overview: Grieving his father, eight-year-old Sam chases a butterfly, saves it from a lake, and tries everything to keep his new companion LouLou alive.

title: Marilyn's Dark Paradise
overview: An adventurous time traveler befriends Marilyn Monroe and struggles with adhering to the rigid rules of time travel.

title: Sins of an Amish Husband
overview: Sarah is a devout Amish woman who suspects foul play after her sister, Ida, dies in a mysterious barn fire. Driven to protect her young nephew, Sarah begins investigating her brother-in-law.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: A Real Grey Area
overview: Attempting to stage an historical reenactment on Coney Island, a contractor working for a powerful client speaks with a representative from a rental company regarding the unconventional use of an electric generator.

title: Roman Charity
overview: Building on my background in academic drawing, I create a painting that reinterprets Rubens’ Roman Charity from the viewpoint of its female figure. This painting then appears as a prop in the video, becoming a means to inscribe my own biography and to explore questions of gaze, female subjectivity, memory, and the boundaries of the permissible.

title: Night of the Screaming Terror
overview: Night Of The Screaming Terror follows Dr Redfern as he visits St Peters mental asylum for the criminally insane. Inside he meets the eccentric Dr Mountford and his group of special patients. Each one with a bizarre and terrifying reason for their eternal detainment in the dark corridors of the asylum.

title: When You See It
overview: While filming the pilot episode of a new indie reality ghost hunting show two ghost hunters question if the paranormal activity they are experiencing is real or an elaborate hoax put on by their fame seeking host.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: Letters
overview: In the school hallway, Anita excitedly tells Chloe that she plans to confess her feelings to Antoni after school. Later, Anita goes to the garden gazebo and is devastated to find Antoni close to Bianca, who is holding Anita's personal love letter. Amidst a sudden thunderstorm, Bianca mocks Anita from afar and embraces Antoni, causing Anita to flee in tears. A flashback reveals that years prior, a science fair project built by Anita and Bianca malfunctioned and exploded in front of a laughing crowd, leading a humiliated Bianca to tear off her matching necklace and blame Anita for ruining her. In the present day, Bianca corners Anita in the school bathroom to confront her about the past. During the heated argument, Bianca admits her deep insecurity and resentment over the science fair disaster. Seeking closure, Anita offers Bianca the "B" necklace she has kept for years, but Bianca refuses it and walks out, leaving Anita alone with her reflection and unresolved tension.

title: Liv's Last Ride
overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

title: SYDNEY CASH MAKES TOO MUCH ART
original_title: SYDNEY CASH MAKES TOO MUCH ART
overview: Sydney Cash is an 80-year-old artist who can’t stop making art. When space runs out and time grows short, his family faces an urgent decision about the fate of his life’s work. Turning the camera on his father’s artistic legacy, a son confronts how a lifetime of compulsive creating impacted their family.

title: Scars and Splinters
overview: A young woman fights for survival against a mysterious botanical infection

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: Mercy
overview: A tense psychological horror short that follows a young woman trapped in a dangerous and unsettling situation, forcing her to confront fear, survival, and a disturbing reality.

title: The flash drive killer case
overview: This Mockumentary horror about officers find flash drive in the park And it was found that there were 3 video clips that were less than 1 minute long, as follows Video 1 Joe Possessed by a ghost and hit on the head into the wall Video 2 a curse movie film scene and Video 3 show William O Jack got shot by Fred and police found out Fred is the owner of that flash drive and the how the flash drive killer case was begin.

title: The Other Room
overview: After a late-night Tinder hookup, a young Black man is cornered by his date's white parents whose wine and questions mask something far worse waiting in the other room.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Gardener's Planet!
overview: A TV Gardener who discovers that the people whose garden he is working on aren't actually people at all but evil aliens from another planet and he has to defeat them before it's too late.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: Inside 'Crystal Lake Memories'
overview: A dark secret from Pamela Voorhees' past emerges after her son's death, just as bodies begin turning up across the quiet town of Crystal Lake.

title: Boy Mom
overview: A nervous woman meets her adult boyfriend's overbearing mother.

title: Doom Lift
overview: When a man and a purple puppet find themselves stuck on a runaway ski lift, they try everything to escape, but each action only brings them closer to their doom!

title: Abnegation
overview: In a world irreversibly damaged by Al data centers, a couple is forced to rely on the very same tool responsible for creating resource scarcity. With the Al in her ear and her thoughts, a wife faces an irrevocable choice.

title: The Day I Met Aretha Franklin
original_title: The Day I Met Aretha Franklin
overview: Two women in a beauty salon transform a playwright’s day before his play world premieres.

title: Carolina Blue
overview: On the cusp of adulthood, A 19-year-old woman who keeps putting off her life is forced into action when her grandfather stops putting off his, setting her on a journey to find him.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Last Night at the Alamo
overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

title: The man formerly known as Maxwell Milk
original_title: The man formerly known as Maxwell Milk
overview: Maxwell details his dairy journey as he mutates into someone unrecognizable.

title: Doober Driver R Us
overview: Mockumentary about Day in the Life of a Doober Driver

title: Psychopomp
overview: To prove she doesn't scare easily, Selena boards a county fair bus that supposedly holds a real demon.

title: You'll Be Fine
overview: A woman slowly realizes her husband may not be who she thinks. Shot in a single unbroken take.

title: JINX
overview: A married couple discovers how dangerous it is to be too much like your partner.

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Musk
overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: Try!
overview: Four Irish Rugby teams who defy stereotypes tackle their way to the Mixed Ability Rugby World Cup, where full-contact sport meets joyful belonging.

title: Imperfect Days
overview: A documentary of sorts

title: What I Want
overview: Struggling to find her footing in her first year of college, Chloe attempts to join the school’s dance company. Unbeknownst to her, the company holds many dark secrets. In this story of love, Chloe faces a challenge— follow her true passions or fall into the pressures of conformity.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: The Christmas Heartbeat
overview: Following sudden cardiac arrest, Julia Winters is forced back to her Nashville hometown, where Christmas never fades and old wounds still linger. To truly move forward, she must confront the past she thought she’d left behind—and the future she never saw coming.

title: Early Human Media
overview: At the end of their second date, Joaquin accepts Misty’s invitation up to her apartment, but the night takes a turn when her eccentric brother subjects him to a surreal trial that leaves him questioning reality and love.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Wolpie of the Woods
overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

title: Birds of Paradise
overview: Two jealous, self-critical birds admire a macho bird from afar, wishing they could be more like him... but the "perfect" image they're comparing themselves to isn't what it seems.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Arctic Annihilation
overview: An earthquake in the Atlantic triggers a devastating drop in global temperatures, plunging the world into a deadly, apocalyptic ice age.

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Dogwood
overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: MAN or MOUNTAIN
overview: Defying evacuation orders and denying scientific evidence, notorious lodge owner Harry R. Truman is sent cascading through memories of a life lived without regret beneath Mt. St. Helens, as mounting tremors rock his cherished world.  Still basking in the limelight of his rebellion, imminent cataclysm forces him to finally face the truth of his grave decision: to be destroyed by what he loved.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Thief of Night
overview: By stealing the beautiful night scenery by heart, thieves understand the pure love and embracement.

title: Mortal Lace
overview: Mortal Lace depicts existence as a conscious hallucination created by our own experience of life. This is explored through the context of a week where each day progress closer to absolute reality.

title: The Maggots
overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Creatures
overview: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

title: Muurbloem
overview: Four of Madelief's best friends join her for dinner. They take a trip down memory lane, while she listens. But as the night continues, her friends push her closer to an uncomfortable reality. Whether's she's ready for it or not.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: The Dog That Couldn't Bark
overview: Rebecca, a woman on her deathbed, is visited by a new nurse, Angelica, who seems to have an ability to draw out her hidden secrets.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: When a coal miner in 1930s Utah hides the loss of his job from his family, the quiet deception sets off a slow-burning collapse.

title: Sport Star
overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Phreaker
overview: Inspired by true events. Before there were hackers, there were phreakers. A blind teenager joins the early underworld of "phone freaks" where he learns to hack his way to money, power, and eventually, a place on the FBI's most wanted list.

title: The Art of Trying
overview: Antonio chose to leave a life of crime behind him after 25 years. He is now homeless and wandering around the same crime-ridden streets trying to make an honest living as a painter.

title: Into the Sky
overview: A man's efforts to win back his wife keep getting derailed when aliens mysteriously snatch him from Earth, making his path to reconciliation a lot more complicated than expected.

title: OLDSKIN/NEWDRUGS
overview: The narrator is a girl. This is mid-July. She's feeling weird. She goes outside.

title: Infinitely Dense
overview: Tom, a painfully pragmatic solipsist, disenchanted with his life, employs an augmented reality system to rejuvenate his life, only to discover the unintended dark and disturbing consequence of manipulating reality.

title: The Long Way to Tipperary
overview: A man returns home.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: The Way Through
overview: Italy, 2035. Mansfield, Stendhal and Buzzati are friends and partisans fighting against the regime. Engaged in relays of coded messages hidden in ciphered books, they are forced into a race against time: the fascists are about to take the town of Ovada.

title: Magpie's Lemonade
overview: An ex-lemonade delivery driver finally attains the promotion of his dreams, but must first prove himself by making a difficult sale.

title: Dying for Love
overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: The Legend of Captain Scarlet
overview: Inspired by the Super Space Theatre compilations of the 1980s. An exclusive new feature-length New Captain Scarlet movie experience.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: Who is Columbus?
overview: Columbus, Ohio born filmmaker Renton Hinderer explores his hometown through the eyes of its residents, weaving together dozens of stories to reveal who this city is and what it's becoming.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: What Love Builds
overview: Follows Crowe's passion for music and his efforts of maintaining it alongside his acting career, showcasing him and his band on their recent tour in Europe, as well as previous shows in the US, UK and Australia.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: True Love
overview: Elliot wants to reconnect with his ex-boyfriend, Will, but a dark turn reveals the true nature of their relationship.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: Vaulder
overview: Something stalks a group at night in the suburbs.

title: 26F Seeking Friend
overview: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

title: & Ever
overview: @rgray828 and @Ever_06 meet for the first time.

title: The Ringing
overview: Jack suffers from relentless ringing in his ears that slowly isolates him from the world around him. As the noise grows unbearable and medical help fails, he takes a horrifying step to reclaim silence, with devastating consequences.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: Super Duper
overview: On the night of a highly anticipated Super Duper Moon, two people embark on an intimate nighttime journey together. As clouds obscure the sky and the night stretches on, anticipation gives way to waiting, uncertainty, and presence. With the spectacle they planned for absent, the meaning of the evening must be negotiated through behavior, silence, and choice—revealing whether love is sustained by symbols or by staying.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: A disgraced councilwoman uncovers a pickleball conspiracy threatening her city and teams up with an unlikely group of allies to stop the town-wide tournament and save her community.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: False Advertising
overview: A job interview becomes a negotiation over identity.

title: Peppermint Pixie Dream Girl
overview: A ditzy waitress named Shirley May Holmes falls head-over-heels for Dorothy, a peppermint-clad pinup girl, but she has much to conquer if she wants to land a kiss from Dorothy's candy lips. Transphobic greasers, hetero-nonsense, and the nuclear blast itself will all come crashing down upon Shirley on this pivotal night... She may just need a little help to make it to sunrise alive.

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Joshua
overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: The State of Us
overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Tinskani: Afterimage
overview: Tinskani mourns the death of his friend and mentor, Salvador. His partner, Citlali, urges him to attend the funeral with her, but Tinskani is haunted by the photograph of his friend's corpse. He'd rather wander through the town’s carnival, camera in hand, seeking to replace that ghostly portrait with new ones.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: The Bay
overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: Before I Do
overview: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom, John Michael, and his best man, Alex, find their past romantic feelings reigniting. Their chemistry entangles the entire wedding party in pre-wedding drama, including friends Luís, Simon, and the newly out and bisexual Kit.

title: THE CAGE WITHIN
overview: A true fight isn’t fought in the ring, but inside the mind.  The Cage Within follows Jake, a young fighter struggling with anger, trauma and the weight of expectations, as he tries to break the cycle of violence that shaped him. Between training, silence and fractured relationships, the film observes a man who chooses not to become what hurt him — even when that choice hurts more.  An intimate, restrained drama about masculinity, control and the quiet cost of change.

title: The Chattanooga Syndrome - NOCLIP 3
overview: In this meta found-footage / documentary escapade, Gavin and Alex head to Tennessee to document the premiere of their previous film, and to follow a tip that will lead them to the most liminal spaces in Chattanooga...

title: Breaking Cover
overview: A seemingly ordinary back-office worker whose father-daughter hunting trip turns into a relentless fight for survival, and the father's past as a covert operative is unearthed.

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
overview: Ready to quit the dating scene altogether, burned-out Leah accepts her grandmother's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights in exchange for a year's rent—only to discover amidst the awkward dinners and unexpected sparks that her biggest obstacle to love is herself.

title: The Quiet After
overview: In a near-future society where grief is erased by law, Noah wakes up with fragments of an unknown woman after a near-fatal accident. Drawn into therapy and reassured by a trusted friend, he begins to piece together the unbearable truth. His search for her, and for himself, becomes an act of defiance against a world that values compliance over love.  Haunted by memory and hunted by the system, Noah is forced to confront the cost of remembering, and the deeper cost of letting go.

title: Death Boom
overview: As a “spiritual follow-up” to 'Fin', 'Death Boom' “pulls back the curtain on the catastrophic mental and environmental impacts of the contemporary death care industry. The film, shown through the lens of the workers at the heart of it as they prepare for the passing of 77 million baby boomers, exposes the toll that embalming, cremation, and traditional burial have on those who’ve passed, their families, and deathcare workers, and the corruption – political, religious, and corporate – that stands in opposition to greener methods being nationally legalized and accessible.”

title: The Siege of Paradise
overview: In Cinque Terre on Italy’s northern Riviera, fewer than 3,000 locals endure over four million tourists each summer.  Across one chaotic season, six very different lives play out in parallel, revealing a sharply funny and surprisingly tender story of paradise under pressure in the age of social media driven tourism.

title: Nocturne in White
overview: An office worker drifts through a nameless government building that runs experiments on humans. As repetition begins to distort her reality, she becomes overwhelmed by the guilt and the sneaking suspicion that she may also be a subject of experimentation.

title: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS The Making Of Magenta House
original_title: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS The Making Of Magenta House
overview: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS is the definitive behind the scenes look at the making of Magenta House using extensive behind the scenes footage shot during the production of the film and interviews with most of the crew and some of the cast. It’s a unique opportunity to showcase the creation of fully independent student film which we had full control over. The good, the bad and the ugly side of film making is on full display going through all the ups and downs of such a production and hearing from those who created it both pre and post filming and right up to the film’s premiere at the Horror On Sea Film Festival.

title: Savage House
overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

title: Imaginal Disk
overview: A cinematic companion to Magdalena Bay's Imaginal Disk, the film expands the album's kaleidoscopic world into a bold, visually driven narrative.

title: Cornellskop: Freedom From Fear
overview: At a South African sanctuary, Luke Cornell provides a second chance for wildlife, confronting the harsh realities of poaching while revealing the deep emotional bond between the animals and those dedicated to their care.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: Waning Love
overview: Rosie is going to break up with her long time boyfriend Liam. She’s thought it all out, except Liam is a werewolf, and tonight is a full moon.
